overall_summary: Analysis of 13 historical videos shows that content centered on complex marital relationships and modern relationship realities significantly outperforms general family or abstract sad poetry. Specifically, husband-wife dynamics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1,718 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1,666 views) generate the highest engagement and views, whereas deep poetic or abstract lines underperform heavily.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on husband-wife and marriage realities (e.g., or5gtaBpRVY, my5mP9feI7s) achieved 1,600+ views, which is 5x-10x higher than average channel performance.
winning_patterns.action: Allocate 70% of upcoming content to nuanced husband-wife and long-term relationship pain points.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framing a direct question or common realization about relationships (e.g., 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota') capture moderate-to-high sustained interest.
winning_patterns.action: Use conversational, grounded relationship situations as primary hooks instead of heavy poetic lines.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' (YdWh4cDOE64) received only 6 views due to overly dramatic or abstract wording that lacks instant everyday visual grounding.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly complex or literary metaphors; anchor scripts in visual, everyday domestic moments.
